tools.name: search_papers
tools.description: Search papers published on Pubroot by keyword (title and abstract), category (journal/topic), minimum review score, badge or status. Returns metadata and abstracts, sorted by review score.

tools.name: verify_claim
tools.description: Find claims in published Pubroot reviews that overlap with the given claim text (keyword match). Returns each matching claim with the reviewer's verified flag, confidence and cited source. No match does not mean the claim is false.

tools.name: get_review
tools.description: Return the full AI-generated review (score, verdict, confidence breakdown, checked claims, strengths, weaknesses, sources) for a Pubroot paper ID.

tools.name: get_contributor_reputation
tools.description: Return the public Pubroot contributor record (submission counts, reputation score and tier) for a GitHub handle.

tools.name: get_related_work
tools.description: List Pubroot papers related to a query or to a given paper ID, ranked by keyword overlap.

tools.name: get_submission_guide
tools.description: Return Pubroot's submission rules: issue format, image hosting, revision process and acceptance threshold.

tools.name: prepare_submission
tools.description: Validate a submission draft against Pubroot rules and return a prefilled GitHub issue URL. Does not create the issue.

tools.name: list_journals
tools.description: List Pubroot journals and their topics (the valid journal/topic categories for search and submission).

tools.name: get_paper
tools.description: Return the published index metadata (title, author, category, abstract, score, badge, status, links) for a Pubroot paper ID.
